title: What a constraint needs to prove.
summary: Evidence, alternatives and ownership in the XiteAI Code.
alt: An open notebook with a pen on a wooden desk
paragraphs: Difficulty and a lack of precedent are not proof that something cannot be done. At XiteAI, a constraint needs to be supported by evidence.
When a constraint is real, we ask for alternatives ranked on merit. The person who raised it owns the path forward until the objective is met.
